kind.description: `movies`, `shows`, `mixed`, or `videos` (home videos and clips: one item per file, never matched).

oneOf.description: Home videos, clips and anything else that is neither a film nor a series (Plex's "Other Videos"): every file is its own item, titled after the file and browsed by folder. Nothing is grouped (no shows, versions or extras; only a true multi-part stack is one item) and nothing is matched against a metadata source.

available.description: `false` while the folder doesn't answer (a NAS asleep, a drive unplugged): its items are kept, shown as offline.

metadata_source.description: What flux matches titles against by itself: `none` (titles come from file names, art from video frames: everything else is up to you), `tmdb`, or `exports` (offline suggestions only).

oneOf.description: None: titles and years come from file and folder names, artwork from frames of the video.
TMDB online, with the server's key (`TMDB_READ_TOKEN` or `TMDB_API_KEY`).
TMDB's daily ID exports, offline: they suggest candidates but accept none on their own (no year or runtime to confirm a match).

policy.description: What flux won't show agents, and the house rules.

withheld.description: Providers whose content flux never shows an agent, because their terms forbid using it with AI (`tmdb`). Fields from them are listed under `withheld` instead of their values: fill them from the open web, in your own words, with sources.

you.description: Who you are to this server.

agent.description: The agent flux takes you for (named by MCP, the `X-Flux-Agent` header or the CLI), or `null` for a person.

login.description: Your login: a Tailscale login, `local` on the server's own machine off the tailnet, or `anonymous`.

may.description: What your role lets you do.

admin.description: Scan libraries, decide proposals, keep lenses for everyone (Owner or Admin).

apply.description: Change things directly: `items.edit` applies, `art.add`, `art.pin`, `changes.undo` (Owner or Admin).

propose.description: Propose changes for an Owner or Admin to review (`items.edit` with mode `propose`; Viewers, Owners and Admins).
